mapper.select: SELECT r.type,r.id,CASE r.type WHEN 'post' THEN 'POST' WHEN 'activity' THEN 'ACTIVITY' ELSE CASE c.target_type WHEN 1 THEN 'POST' WHEN 2 THEN 'ACTIVITY' WHEN 3 THEN 'PUBLIC_EVENT' WHEN 8 THEN 'ARTICLE' END END namespace, g.organization_id FROM (SELECT #{r.type} type,#{r.id} id) r LEFT JOIN comment c ON r.type='comment' AND c.id=r.id LEFT JOIN post p ON p.id=CASE WHEN r.type='post' THEN r.id WHEN c.target_type=1 THEN c.target_id END LEFT JOIN activity a ON a.id=CASE WHEN r.type='activity' THEN r.id WHEN c.target_type=2 THEN c.target_id END LEFT JOIN public_event e ON c.target_type=3 AND e.id=c.target_id LEFT JOIN article ar ON c.target_type=8 AND ar.id=c.target_id LEFT JOIN post_growth_record g ON g.post_id=p.id WHERE (r.type='post' AND p.id IS NOT NULL) OR (r.type='activity' AND a.id IS NOT NULL) OR (r.type='comment' AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND (p.id IS NOT NULL OR a.id IS NOT NULL OR e.id IS NOT NULL OR ar.id IS NOT NULL))
